HAWUD Plastic Distribution Box with Kalki Breakers
• Available in 8-Way, 12-Way, and 24-Way module capacity
• Flame-retardant surface & flush mount electrical enclosure
• Equipped with smoked transparent protective cover & DIN-rail mounting
• Includes heavy-duty Kalki miniature circuit breakers

@Luxuryelectrical

KK Electric 220V LED Strip Power Connectors & Plugs
• Heavy-duty pre-wired power lead connectors for 220V continuous LED strips
• Dual-prong pin connector with secure snap-in insulation housing
• Compatible with single-color and multi-channel strip installations

@Luxuryelectrical

Tisesoi® 6W Vintage Edison ST64 Filament Bulb
• Classic antique ST64 teardrop design with amber-tinted glass
• Energy-saving 6W LED filament replacing 60W traditional incandescent bulbs
• Standard E27 screw base delivering 2200K warm vintage ambient illumination

@Luxuryelectrical

H.S Power Multi-Core Copper Electrical Cables
• Premium 100% electrolytic pure copper conductors with tough PVC insulation
• Available sizes: 2x1.5, 2x2.5, 2x4, 2x6, 3x4, 3x6 mm²
• Supplied in factory-sealed 100-meter rolls with certified standard gauge

@Luxuryelectrical

High-Density 220V Commercial LED Strip Reel (100m)
• Continuous 100-meter commercial spool with high diode density SMD LEDs
• Direct 220V mains input without bulky external desktop transformers
• Weatherproof IP65 clear silicone jacket for indoor & outdoor architectural use

@Luxuryelectrical

Micro breaker 25w
• Micro breaker 25w rated current for residential & motor branch protection
• 400V~ 50Hz with 6000A short-circuit breaking capacity (IEC standard)
• Compact single-pole DIN-rail standard 35mm clip-on mounting with contact status window

@Luxuryelectrical

AuraLight 0.7 Recessed Slim Downlight (6W)
• Ultra-slim 6W recessed ceiling downlight available in Round & Square profiles
• Anti-glare frosted optical diffuser producing soft, uniform illumination
• Clean matte white bezel seamlessly blending with modern ceilings

@Luxuryelectrical

KK Electric 2.5W Mini Recessed Spot Light
• High-lumen COB LED mini spotlight with deep-set anti-glare reflector
• Included isolated constant-current LED driver (Input: AC 85-265V 50/60Hz)
• Available in sleek Matte Black and Clean White finish bezels

@Luxuryelectrical

Luxury Slim Circular LED Ceiling Panel Light
• High-lumen circular ceiling panel with 85% energy conservation
• Available wattage options: 24W and 36W high-performance SMD arrays
• Long 30,000-hour rated operating lifespan with high color rendering (CRI > 80)
• External constant-current driver ensuring flicker-free stable illumination
• Certified for retail showrooms, commercial offices & modern homes

@Luxuryelectrical

SAGE Luxury Matte Black Switch & Socket Collection
• Premium architectural switch & socket collection in velvety matte black finish
• Comprehensive range: Single Switch, Double Switch, Triple Switch, Sockets
• Multi-gang combo units: Combined Socket + Switch, and TV + Power Socket
• High-grade fire-resistant polycarbonate plate with smooth tactile actuation

@LuxuryElectrical

Heavy-Duty 150W Commercial Outdoor LED Street Light
• High-power 150W luminaire with 3 high-intensity COB LED optical lenses
• Rugged aerodynamic die-cast aluminum housing with ribbed cooling heatsink
• IP66 weatherproof rating engineered to withstand rain, dust & harsh conditions
• Standard pole-mount collar with dual set-screws for compound security

KK Electric Recessed LED Downlight (ጎርግዋዳ)
• Deep-recessed (ጎርግዋዳ) anti-glare downlight for comfortable ambient lighting
• Available in timeless Clean White (ነጭ) and Matte Black (ጥቁር) trims

• Chrome accent inner ring delivering a high-end luxury aesthetic
